theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lp_covector_norm_bounds
theorems.statement: (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid N) k) (τ : Fin k → Euclid N), Orthonormal ℝ τ → |α τ| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
